papers.title: DMMU: SmartNIC-Based On-Device MMU for Scalable Virtualized I/O and Memory Overcommitment
papers.summary: 针对SR-IOV虚拟化中VF数量增长导致主机IOMMU的IOTLB容量不足、吞吐下降，以及无法识别DMA区域而必须锁定全部VM内存的问题，提出部署于可编程SmartNIC的DMMU。其combo-DMA依据IOMMU负载，在主机IOMMU与网卡片上翻译引擎之间动态路由地址转换；direct-PRI则允许SmartNIC直接向宿主机驱动发送缺页请求，绕过传统PRI的多层模拟。系统通过微代码更新部署在双端口100G NIC上，在Intel Skylake与Ice Lake服务器、120个VF的代表性配置下，相比基线IOMMU将NIC吞吐提升65%，IOTLB未命中降低38倍，并解除整VM内存固定以支持内存超配。其价值在于把虚拟I/O地址转换和页故障处理卸载到旁路硬件，对Linux virtio-net、RDMA及云网络数据面具有启发；但原摘要未给出绝对吞吐、时延、CPU占用及真实工作负载分布，硬件可编程性和微代码依赖也限制通用性。
papers.summary_en: Cloud data centers increasingly rely on device virtualization to share high-bandwidth network adapters and accelerators among virtual machines (VMs). Single Root I/O Virtualization (SR-IOV) exposes Virtual Functions (VFs) directly to guest VMs, but the Input/Output Memory Management Unit (IOMMU) on the host processor becomes a bottleneck as the number of VFs grows: its small translation lookaside buffer (TLB) causes severe throughput degradation. papers.title: ExpLinux: Reproducible Linux kernel exploit labs from public CVE disclosures

papers.summary_en: Public proof-of-concept exploits for Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities often depend on undocumented environmental assumptions, limiting their reproducibility. This paper presents ExpLinux , a methodology and framework for converting public vulnerability artifacts into reproducible, mitigation-aware exploitation labs.
